create_emissions_graph: create an emissions graph from a vector of emission probabilities with time steps T and alphabet size N
build_ctc_graph: build a CTC alignment graph from a target label sequence and a blank token index
test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by computing forward scores, loss, and gradients on emission graphs
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emission, transition, and label graphs to compute loss and gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG viterbi path decoding by composing emission and transition graphs and extracting the best label path
